title: runtime: a refused package publish still runs the publish-drafts visibility flip, so an app already active for the package is unhidden
body:
domain:server#6 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnTcb4cZVkPdhkPicW

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named producer (class b, an out-of-scope finding of PR #32454 for #32396; the seat files it).
reach: named producer, read from code and not yet measured through the door. The `POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts` handler (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, the ADR-0045 visibility-flip block) runs whatever `publishPackageDrafts` returns. ⚠ First step: measure it once through the door. Use a package whose app is already active and whose publish is refused by a later draft, then read the app's `_unpublished`.

## What happens (code reading)

After `publishPackageDrafts` returns, the handler flips the package's visibility, setting `_unpublished: false` on apps already ACTIVE for the package. It checks no outcome before the flip. So a refused publish (the batch rolled back, `publishedCount: 0`) can still unhide an app that the operator kept hidden.

## Expected

ADR-0067 D2: "no partial visibility flip". A refused or failed publish flips nothing; the flip runs only on a fully published batch.

## Business reason

Who: operators publishing a package whose app is staged hidden. Without it, a refused publish exposes the app in the launcher anyway, which is the exact symptom #32396 reported, by a second path.

## Reader

The `domain:server` seat that claims it after triage, once PR #32454 (#32396) has landed. That PR makes the batch itself all-or-nothing on runtimes without rollback.

## Duplicate check

`gh api search/issues`, `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue`, open and closed, 2026-11-11: `publish-drafts visibility flip refused` 28 hits, the first three #32396 (this defect's parent), #25467 and #29893, neither of which covers this. `unhiddenApps publish` 9 hits: #5242 (closed) concerns a flip that fails midway dropping `unhiddenApps` from the response, not a flip after a refused publish. No card for this.
